title: Kyiv Formally Rejects Trump's Call to Replace Zelensky; Drones Hit Russian Data Hub
detail: Ukraine formally rejected Trump's demand for a new Ukrainian president, declaring Zelensky's replacement non-negotiable. In a separate development, Ukrainian drones struck a Russian data hub — marking a new category of infrastructure target in Ukraine's campaign to degrade Russian rear-area capabilities.

title: Zelensky Offers to Halt Oil Refinery Drone Strikes if Russia Stops Attacking Ukrainian Energy
detail: Zelensky signaled conditional willingness to halt Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries — but only if Russia stops attacking Ukrainian energy infrastructure. The reciprocal offer sets up a potential de-escalation exchange in the energy domain of the conflict.

title: Analysis: Ukraine's Precision Drones Systematically Degrading Russian Oil Refinery Output
detail: Washington Post analysis details how Ukraine's precision drone campaign has systematically degraded Russian oil refinery output, hobbling a key revenue source for the Russian war economy. The sustained campaign represents a strategic effort to erode Russia's capacity to finance the war.

title: Trump Announces Russia-Ukraine Energy Ceasefire; Zelenskyy Says 'News to Me'
detail: Trump announced a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire agreement, but Zelenskyy publicly said the deal was 'news to me,' creating a sharp public contradiction between Washington and Kyiv. Zelenskyy later signaled conditional openness to an energy truce — but only if Russia halts strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, framing the offer as reciprocal rather than capitulation.
